cards.objective:
Link shortener

Build a link shortener: a Go API and a TypeScript single-page frontend (Vite, React), one image, as AGENTS.md lays out.

Accounts: sign up with an email and a password (at least 10 characters, bcrypt), log in, log out. A session is an HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax cookie.
Links: a logged-in user shortens an http or https URL of at most 2048 characters, with an optional custom slug [a-z0-9-]{3,32}; otherwise the slug is 7 random characters. A user lists their own links with click counts and deletes their own. Another user's link answers 404.
Redirect: GET /<slug> answers 302 to the target and counts a click (total and per UTC day). An unknown slug answers 404.
Stats: per link, the clicks per day of the last 30 days.
QR code: GET /api/links/<slug>/qr answers a PNG of the short URL.
Rate limits: at most 10 sign-up or log-in attempts per minute per client address, and 30 new links per hour per user; beyond, 429.
Storage: SQLite through modernc.org/sqlite (pure Go) at $DATA_DIR/links.db, migrations embedded and named by UTC timestamp.
API (JSON): POST /api/signup, POST /api/login, POST /api/logout, GET /api/me, GET /api/links, POST /api/links, DELETE /api/links/<slug>, GET /api/links/<slug>/stats, GET /api/links/<slug>/qr, GET /healthz.
Pages under /app/: sign up, log in, my links (create, list with counts, copy, delete), link detail (a bar per day for 30 days, the QR code), not found. / redirects to /app/.
Deploy: one Deployment with one replica and strategy Recreate (the volume is ReadWriteOnce, so a rolling update would stall on the second pod's attach), a 1 GiB volume at $DATA_DIR, a Service on 8080, staging only.

Acceptance tests (Go, in acceptance/, against the server in httptest, run by go test ./...):
A1 sign up, log in, GET /api/me names the user; log out, /api/me answers 401.
A2 create a link; GET /<slug> answers 302 with the target in Location; the list shows 1 click.
A3 a custom slug taken twice answers 409; a URL of scheme ftp answers 400.
A4 a second user deleting the first user's link answers 404, and the link still redirects.
A5 stats answer 30 days, today's count 2 after two redirects.
A6 the QR endpoint answers image/png, a decodable PNG.
A7 the eleventh log-in attempt within a minute answers 429.
A8 GET /app/ and GET /app/links/abc answer the index page with <div id="root">.
A9 GET /nope123 answers 404.

Accounts: sign up with an email and a password (at least 10 characters, bcrypt), log in, log out. A session is an HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax cookie.
Links: a logged-in user shortens an http or https URL of at most 2048 characters, with an optional custom slug [a-z0-9-]{3,32}; otherwise the slug is 7 random characters. A user lists their own links with click counts and deletes their own. Another user's link answers 404.
Redirect: GET /<slug> answers 302 to the target and counts a click (total and per UTC day). An unknown slug answers 404.
Stats: per link, the clicks per day of the last 30 days.
QR code: GET /api/links/<slug>/qr answers a PNG of the short URL.
Rate limits: at most 10 sign-up or log-in attempts per minute per client address, and 30 new links per hour per user; beyond, 429.
Storage: SQLite through modernc.org/sqlite (pure Go) at $DATA_DIR/links.db, migrations embedded and named by UTC timestamp.
API (JSON): POST /api/signup, POST /api/login, POST /api/logout, GET /api/me, GET /api/links, POST /api/links, DELETE /api/links/<slug>, GET /api/links/<slug>/stats, GET /api/links/<slug>/qr, GET /healthz.
